# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.5 Module 16.5-B: Sovereign Finance, Central Banks & Speculative Bubble Disaster (oe_fin_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v165_finance_twilight.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize bounded Sovereign Finance state variables once.
oe_fin_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_bubble_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_heat value = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_stabilization_steps } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_stabilization_steps value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_fin_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Adjust speculative bubble heat clamped to [0, 100].
oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_bubble_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_heat value = 20 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_heat add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_heat min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Increment crisis stabilization progress clamped to [0, 10].
oe_fin_bump_stabilization = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_stabilization_steps } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_stabilization_steps value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_fin_stabilization_steps add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_fin_stabilization_steps min = 0 max = 10 }
}

# Country scope. Yearly Sovereign Finance progression & 16-event chronological/dynamic dispatcher.
oe_fin_country_yearly = {
	oe_fin_init_host = yes

	# Yearly bubble heat drift from sovereign leverage, inflation, overseas boom & cabinet oversight.
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { num_loans >= 4 inflation >= 0.06 } }
		oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_bonds_cab_active }
		oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_audit_cab_active }

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_fin_mod_central_bank_charter }

# Any scope. Exported zero-slot yearly dispatcher hook for oe_global_kernel_effects.txt.
# Zero cost prior to 1660; bounded sweep over eligible sovereign financial powers thereafter.
oe_fin_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1660
			NOT = { global_var:oe_fin_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_fin_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = { oe_fin_is_financial_power = yes }
			oe_fin_country_yearly = yes
		}
	}
}
